hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) RUFF=ruff; [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/venv/bin/ruff" ] && RUFF="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/venv/bin/ruff"; [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff" ] && RUFF="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff"; if ! out=$("$RUFF" check "$f" 2>&1 && "$RUFF" format --check "$f" 2>&1); then echo "ruff found issues in $f (run: ruff check --fix \"$f\" && ruff format \"$f\"):"; echo "$out"; exit 2; fi ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Running ruff on edited Python file...
